name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Lichen goes with Dasari or Pilot goes with Regolith.
Pilot goes with at least one of Dasari, Okafor, or Fungus.
Either Regolith goes with Pilot or Medic does not go with Fontaine (but not both) if and only if Fungus goes with Captain.
Between Basalt and Regolith, one goes with Anders and the other with Fontaine.
Fungus, Lichen, and Regolith go with Dasari, Fontaine, and Botanist, in some order.

hints.text: Suppose Okafor went with Basalt — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Okafor goes with Basalt.
Basalt goes with Okafor, so Anders can't go with Basalt.
Basalt goes with Okafor, so Fontaine can't go with Basalt.
…but now the clue “Between Basalt and Regolith, one goes with Anders and the other with Fontaine” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Okafor does not go with Basalt.
